newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Bogo Medellin to form agricultural unit.
newsitem.headline: Bogo Medellin to form agricultural unit.

text.p: Philippine sugar miller Bogo-Medellin Milling Co Inc said on Thursday its board had approved the establishment of a unit to assist in the development and cultivation of private agricultural lands.
The company will spin off its division that currently manages sugar lands in Cebu in central Philippines into a separate company, an official of the firm told Reuters.

"We are managing between 100 to 170 hectares of sugar lands in Cebu province at present. We want to put a name to this division to separate it from our sugar milling," the official who requested not to be named said.
Bogo-Medellin is a unit of Jardine Davies Inc.
